suggestions.title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
suggestions.description: King Arthur and his Knights of the Round Table embark on a gloriously absurd quest for the Holy Grail, battling a killer rabbit, a taunting Frenchman, and a very persistent Black Knight. Monty Python's cult classic is the ultimate absurdist comedy — endlessly quotable, endlessly rewatchable, and still one of the funniest films ever made.

suggestions.title: Wings of Desire
suggestions.description: Two invisible angels drift through a divided Berlin, listening to the secret thoughts of its lonely inhabitants — until one of them falls in love with a trapeze artist and longs to become human. Wim Wenders' poetic, hauntingly beautiful masterpiece, shot in luminous black-and-white and color by Henri Alekan, is pure cinematic poetry about love, mortality, and the miracle of everyday life.

suggestions.title: Casino Royale
suggestions.description: Daniel Craig reinvents James Bond in a stunning debut — a raw, brutal, high-stakes origin story that pits the newly-minted 007 against terrorist financier Le Chiffre in a winner-takes-all poker game at Casino Royale. The Bond franchise's boldest reinvention: gritty, elegant, and crowned by one of cinema's greatest action openings.
